notes.title: Version 0.1.df7060ae
notes.notes:
Hello, dear Greenfeet friends! May the grass be soft beneath your feet!

Here's this week changelog for the closed alpha. You can read more on my dev blog!

If you want to get access to the game, please join my discord and apply for the playtester role!

Added

- Added: Zone-based craft orders can now be edited.
- Added: Cooked version of all vegetables.
- Added: Cooking pot.

Changes

- Changed: Improved main menu visuals, added more infos and links.
- Changed: Craft actions are now unlocked when building the corresponding furniture.
- Changed: Items are usable in the discovery bench only if they were crafted/gathered once.
- Changed: Improved structure preview panel.
- Changed: Recipe now show work amount instead of time.

Fixes

- Fixed: Roofs not being built under some circumstances.
- Fixed: Greenfeet switching tools in a loop while evaluating jobs.
- Fixed: Recipe attempt not locking in.
- Fixed: Campfire sound still playing if the campfire runs out of wood.
- Fixed: Some daylight sound FX playing at night.
- Fixed: Fixed selection marks not showing around structures.
- Fixed: Fixed durability of tools not being decreased.
- Fixed: Fixed craft jobs not despawned with a furniture.

notes.title: Version 0.1.816e06a6
notes.notes:
Hello, dear Greenfeet friends! May the grass be soft beneath your feet!

Here's this week changelog for the closed alpha. You can read more on my dev blog!

If you want to get access to the game, please join my discord and apply for the playtester role!

Added

- Added: Trees will periodically spawn branches.
- Added: Big rocks will periodically spawn stones.
- Added: Added label under discoveries and ability to skip the animation.
- Added: The discovery bench now supports drag and drop.
- Added: Items placed in the discovery bench can be taken back.
- Added: Sub-menu to create zones faster.
- Added: Ability to minimize the tutorial.


Changes

- Changed: Drop spots have been removed in favor of zone-based settings.
- Changed: Game now starts unpaused if tutorials are disabled.
- Changed: UI tweaks to avoid confusion on the "Dismantle" button on furnitures.
- Changed: Tutorial buttons are more visible.
- Changed: Started re-working the crafting UI.

Fixes

- Fixed: Moving out items not taking into account some jobs.
- Fixed: Zones not being deindexed when deleted.

notes.title: Version 0.1.3a052d25
notes.notes:
Hello, dear Greenfeet friends! May the grass be soft beneath your feet!

Here's this week changelog for the closed alpha. You can read more on my dev blog!

If you want to get access to the game, please join my discord and apply for the playtester role!

Added

- Added: Ability to go back to main menu.
- Added: Clothes display in greenfeet equipment view.
- Added: Game over screen when all the greenfeet are dead.
- Added: Craftable torches.
- Added: Hard stone workshop that provides the "Strike" action.
- Added: Greenfeet will now move out items that block other jobs.

Changes

- Changed: Removed hover effect on unexplored areas and replaced it with a pointer cursor.
- Changed: Reduced spatialized sounds volume.
- Changed: Sharp stone recipe.
- Changed: Reworked discovery bench UI.
- Changed: Changed wording for some of the tutorial lines to be more explicit.
- Changed: Crafting during tutorial is now faster.

Fixes

- Fixed: Fixed discovery bench menu entry glowing for discovered items that have no crafting use.
- Fixed: Loading savegames crashing if snow is present in the current game.
- Fixed: Performance regression during snow storms.
- Fixed: Ambient music stacking multiple time when saving/loading.
- Fixed: Wrong rendering of tall grass when season changing from cold to warm.
- Fixed: Multiple issues in the region system causing ghost regions and ghosts jobs slowly killing the game.
- Fixed: Random issue causing the greenfeet to be invisible when the game starts.

notes.title: Version 0.1.373439d3
notes.notes:
Hello, dear Greenfeet friends! May the grass be soft beneath your feet!

Here's this week changelog for the closed alpha. You can read more on my dev blog!

If you want to get access to the game, please join my discord and apply for the playtester role!

Added

Added: Greenfeet now have skills determining their work speed on given tasks. Skills level can be gained by working.
Added: Greenfeet now have background stories influencing their initial skill set.
Added: Greenfeet now have traits that alter their personality, attributes and skills.
Added: Greenfeet now have feelings that can be triggered and will temporarily alter their mood.
Added: Greenfeet now have a birthday and will age each year.

Changes

Changed: Reworked the greenfeet UI panel to be more concise and to display new skills / traits / feelings system.

Fixes

Fixed: Fixed plant not clickable and displayed under everything else after loading a save.
Fixed: Fixed planting crop on farmland having no visible effect.

notes.title: Version 0.1.9dc7809a
notes.notes:
Hello, dear Greenfeet friends! May the grass be soft beneath your feet!

Here's this week changelog for the closed alpha. You can read more on my dev blog!

If you want to get access to the game, please join my discord and apply for the playtester role!

Added

-  Added: Greenfeet will now attempt to recover from obstacles and inconsistencies in paths.

Changes

-  Changed: New progression system with the Discovery bench windows.
-  Changed: The Encyclopedia has been temporarily disabled.
-  Changed: Added hierarchical display to the inventory.
-  Changed: Greenfeet now occupies a whole tile.

Fixes

-  Fixed: Fixed food not showing in the inventory screen.
-  Fixed: Scroll accumulated while hovering an UI.
-  Fixed: Trees not appearing while loading game.
-  Fixed: Fixed terrain variation visible above artificial floors.
-  Fixed: Fixed another batch of depths issues.
-  Fixed: Fixed altered tiles being slightly less crossable than others.
-  Fixed: Broken links between furnitures after loading a save.
-  Fixed: Recovering from interrupted animations when the game is loaded.
-  Fixed: Wrong visual offsets for an item grabbed from storage.
-  Fixed: "Strip" and "Unroof" actions not applicable to tiles without walls.
-  Fixed: "Strip" and "Unroof" actions altering terrains and structures.
-  Fixed: Starving greenfeet stopping eating to go eat another food.
-  Fixed: Activities reservations not cleared when the activity is done.
-  Fixed: Mushrooms not being clickable and not despawning when harvested.

Known issues

-  Issue: The crafting tutorial is broken and will be patched in the update next week.

notes.title: Version 0.1.036496d6
notes.notes:
Hello, dear Greenfeet friends! May the grass be soft beneath your feet!

Here's this week changelog for the closed alpha. You can read more on my dev blog!

If you want to get access to the game, please join my discord and apply for the playtester role!

Added

- Added: Passive notification for problematic jobs.
- Added: Name display under a greenfeet.
- Added: Animations for sitting and lying in bed.
- Added: Exploration preparation phase. Greenfeet will now walk to the region to explore.
- Added: New gatherable non-vegetal entities like clay piles and big rocks.

Changes

- Changed: New grabbing and dropping animations.
- Changed: Exploration settings are now shared to all sectors.
- Changed: Tools are now consumed the same way food is when exploration starts.
- Changed: Explorable sectors reduced to the area available for the upcoming demo.
- Changed: Simpler inventory display as base work for a future major improvement.

Fixes

- Fixed: Preview shadow being rendered if the selected entity is destroyed.
- Fixed: Passive notifications preventing from clicking the menu.
- Fixed: Health bar having the wrong offset.
- Fixed: Savegame taking a lot of disk space.
- Fixed: Plants damage animation not triggering.
- Fixed: Broken lights after loading a save.
- Fixed: Action placeholder blinking when drawing a selection box.

notes.title: Version 0.1.1339be0a
notes.notes:
Hello, dear Greenfeet friends! May the grass be soft beneath your feet!

Here's this week changelog for the closed alpha. You can read more on my dev blog!

If you want to get access to the game, please join my discord and apply for the playtester role!

Added

- Added: Added a "forever" option in zone craft settings.

Changes

- Changed Greenfeet will now equip items by themselve if needed for a job.
- Changed: Outfit creation has been temporarily disabled and will be reworked to match the new auto-equip system.
- Changed: "Outfit storage" is now called "Gear storage" in the zone job UI.
- Changed: Upgraded game engine (bevy) to latest version (0.15).
- Changed: Zone job are now set to "everything from 9am to 18pm" by default.
- Changed: Splitted "Farm" zone job task restriction into "Gather", "Grow" and "Plow".
- Changed: Mouse cursor is no longer FPS restricted.
- Changed: Zone labels are hidden by default.

Fixes

- Fixed: Fixed crash on some passive notification edge cases.
- Fixed: Job evaluator missing some jobs.

notes.title: Version 0.1.d1bb7f8c
notes.notes:
Hello, dear Greenfeet friends! May the grass be soft beneath your feet!

Here's this week changelog for the closed alpha. You can read more on my dev blog!

If you want to get access to the game, please join my discord and apply for the playtester role!

Additions

- Added: Arrows that lead to the current selection if it is offscreen.
- Added: Name of the zones the greenfeet use as house in their preview.
- Added: Cause of death in the notification.
- Added: Job evaluator that analyzes undoable jobs and explains why.
- Added: Greenfeet's schedule in the greenfeet overview.

Changes

- Changed: The bottom menu has been reworked to be more hierarchical.
- Changed: The remove action is now grouped with the cancel action.
- Changed: It is now possible to remove floor, walls and roofs separately.
- Changed: Improved the look of item tags in tooltip and descriptions.
- Changed: Improved the look of progress bars, adding borders, glow and blink animation.
- Changed: Modernized the job preview panel to match other preview panels.
- Changed: Replaced weekly schedule by a uniform schedule.

Fixes

- Fixed: Fixed greenfeet hair's lightmap wrongly offseted.
- Fixed: Closing the preview panel keeping the selection active.
- Fixed: Task restrictions being ignored.
- Fixed: Task restrictions "bleeding" into other zones. A greenfeet allowed to do task X in zone A could do task X in zone B.

notes.title: Version 0.1.692782f5
notes.notes:
Hello, dear Greenfeet friends! May the grass be soft beneath your feet!

Here's this week changelog for the closed alpha. You can read more on my dev blog!

If you want to get access to the game, please join my discord and apply for the playtester role!

Additions

- Added: Dirt roads can be built.

Changes

- Changed: "Harvest" and "Cut" actions are now merged under the same action "Gather".
- Changed: "Remove" action now also orders to cut plants.
- Changed: "Forestry" and "Harvesting" zone automations are merged under one "Gathering" automation.
- Changed: Campfire now consumes flammable items.
- Changed: Each plant can now have optional or mandatory tool requirements.

Fixes

- Fixed: Work progress bar overflowing on short takss.
- Fixed: Campfire animation breaking when the furniture is selected.
- Fixed: Duplicated zones when saving and reloading multiple times.
- Fixed: All zones becoming temporarily visible after loading a save.
- Fixed: Teleported greenfeet after loading a save.
- Fixed: Exploring greenfeet starving to death or collapsing from exhaustion.
- Fixed: Super speed not triggered when greenfeet are exploring while all other are asleep.

notes.title: Version 0.1.30cc321a
notes.notes:
Hello, dear Greenfeet friends! May the grass be soft beneath your feet!

Here's this week changelog for the closed alpha. You can read more on my dev blog!

If you want to get access to the game, please join my discord and apply for the playtester role!

Additions

- Added: Idling greenfeet will go inside (preferably home) to fullfil their needs for shelter.
- Added: Shelter is now taken into account when looking up for a bed.
- Added: Tutorial skip is now memorized between games.
- Added: Enclosed areas with a roof are now considered as indoor.

Changes

- Changed: Balanced needs and their impact on morale.
- Changed: Upgraded the region system to produce regions that share the same zone(s).
- Changed: Long sleeps are more likely to occur at night or else during long free times.

Fixes

- Fixed: Bad housing + bed detection leading to greenfeet collapsing instead of voluntarily sleeping on the ground.
- Fixed: Actively used furnitures still listed as available activities for others.
- Fixed: Zone inhabitants list broken after loading a save.
- Fixed: Notifications not showing anymore after loading a save.
- Fixed: Incompleted cleanup of entities upon loading a save, leading to huge lag and visual glitches.
- Fixed: Cloudy weather not expanding to the whole map.
- Fixed: Game visuals incompletely loaded on the first 2 frames.
- Fixed: Wrong remaining time displayed in exploration progress bar.
